contract: F-8, the update policy keys of config/policy.json (plan Appendix B; docs/app-updates.md §8.1, §3.6; W-13)

readers.updatePolicy: readUpdatePolicy(configDir) (src/main/services/policy.ts): install allowed|managed|invalid, maxVersion (the max_version text, or null), file read|none|unreadable; dev and packaged alike (the reader takes no build)
readers.privacy: loadPolicy (dev and packaged): equal to the same file without its updates block, for every vector whose bytes parse (as UTF-8, nothing stripped) to an object

parts: as f24-markers: a vector's bytes are its parts joined, `text` as UTF-8, `base64` decoded, `repeat` repeated `times` times. Bytes the repo hygiene nets refuse in a text file under tests/ (a NUL, a byte-order mark) and bytes that are not UTF-8 are held as base64. `absent`: no policy.json. `folder`: a folder at policy.json. `link`: policy.json is a symbolic link, to a file holding the parts (`file`) or to nothing (`dangling`). `denyRead`: the file holds the parts and the reader is refused reading it. `drive`: config/drive.json exists (default true)
maxVersionField: a vector's maxVersion is the text of the max_version the reader returns, or null. It is null whenever install is not allowed: a cap means nothing while every install is blocked

writers.why: the HEAD writers emit X: buildPolicyJson and both prepare-drive twins, and the Kit builders pass the Kit switch

junk.why: each value replaces the key's value in `base` (for `updates`, the whole block; for `allow_online_check`, the key is added to the block); every one gives `expect`. The max_version row also runs every string of semver.invalid (expect invalid) and every string of semver.valid (expect allowed, maxVersion that string)
